blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit—or lack thereof—of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear.
In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh:

在本文中,我们试图转载最近报告从AMR扩增中取得大量下游收益的著作,发现这些收益可能是由于所使用的实验环境中的具体选择:使用一致和统一的超参数选择协议,我们观察到,仅文本基准始终符合或超过AMR增强模型的性能。 为了调查这一无效结果,我们引入了一个基于迷惑性的探测器,测量AMR提供具有模型尚不具备的补充关系知识的LLM的程度。 我们发现,AMR扩增无助于LLMs在句子中改善他们对关系内容的理解,表明用AMR扩增这些模型对下游任务没有明显的好处.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The Abstract Meaning Representation ( Banarescu et al., 2013 , AMR;) framework is designed to provide structured, interpretable encodings of sentence meaning. AMR makes explicit the individual relations between entities and events that are represented in a given sentence, breaking down complex meaning into more atomic relations. In addition, AMR strips away stylistic and other aspects of plain text that are irrelevant to meaning, exposing only the semantically relevant information.
blocks.zh: 抽象含义表示法(Banarescu等人,2013年,AMR;)框架旨在提供结构化,可解释的句义编码. AMR明确了特定句子中所代表的实体与事件之间的个别关系,将复杂的含义细分为更多的原子关系. 此外,AMR剥离了与意义无关的纯文本的文体和其他方面,只暴露了与语义相关的信息.

blocks.en: This popular semantic representation (SR) format has historically been used to improve performance across various NLP tasks, including Information Retrieval and Extraction ( Xu et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Ji, 2021 ) , Question Answering ( Bonial et al., 2020 ) , Summarization ( Hua et al., 2023 ; Hua et al., 2022 ) , and Paraphrase Generation ( Huang et al., 2022 ) —in particular in systems built on earlier generations of language models (LMs), such as BERT ( Devlin et al., 2019 ) and T5 ( Raffel et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种流行的语义表达(SR)格式在历史上被用于改善NLP各项任务的业绩,包括信息检索和提取(徐等人,2022年;张和智,2021年),问题回答(Bonial等人,2020年),总结 (Hua等人, 2023年;Hua等人, 2022年),以及 Parater Senter (Huang等人, 2022年)——特别是在基于早期语言模型(LMs)的系统上,如BERT(Devlin等人, 2019年)和T5(Raffel等人, 2020年).

blocks.en: However, the raw capabilities of modern Large Language Models (LLMs) call into question the benefit of SRs such as AMR for NLP tasks. It is thus far unclear whether SRs can be used to meaningfully augment current, SoTA LLMs: while prior work has shown that AMR representations do not improve the performance of GPT-4 OpenAI (2023) in a zero-/few-shot setting Jin et al. (2024) , Zhang et al. (2025) indicate that AMR augmentation can benefit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) via supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

blocks.en: In this work, we analyze in-depth the effectiveness of AMR augmentation for open-weight LLMs. First, we find that the results reported by Zhang et al. (2025) are not generally reproducible when reimplementing their experiments (see Figure 1 ): the observed performance gains from AMR over the base LLM in that work likely arose from highly specific experimental configurations and custom datasets. In particular, we find no clear improvement from AMR integration, despite substantial fine-tuning using multiple fine-tuning strategies.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们深入分析开放量级有限责任公司AMR扩增的有效性。 首先,我们发现,Zhang等人(2025年)所报告的结果在重新进行实验时一般不能复制(见图1):在这项工作中观测到的AMR比基LLM的性能收益可能来自高度具体的实验配置和定制数据集. 特别是,我们发现,尽管采用多种微调战略进行了大幅度的微调,但从AMR的整合方面没有明显的改进。

blocks.en: Furthermore, we evaluate AMR integration for more complex, long-text tasks such as multi-sentence event argument extraction, to control for the possibility that the observed failure of AMR integration to improve performance on the simple, single-sentence tasks of Zhang et al. (2025) may be due to saturation on those benchmarks: if the models have already reached peak performance on these tasks, we do not expect any method—including AMR integration—to further increase their scores. However, we find that even on these more complex, multi-sentence tasks, AMR integration fails to yield any improvement over the base models.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们评价AMR集成对于更复杂的长文任务,如多判决事件论证提取,以控制所观察到的AMR集成在张等人的简单单一判决任务上改善性能的失败(2025年)可能是由于这些基准的饱和:如果模型在这些任务上已经达到顶峰性能,我们并不期望有任何方法——包括AMR集成——来进一步提高它们的分数. 然而,我们发现,即使在这些更为复杂、多判决的任务中,AMR的整合也无法产生比基本模型的任何改进。

blocks.en: Given that AMR consistently fails to improve LLM performance across integration strategies and task types, we hypothesize that AMR does not provide an LLM with any relational information that is not already available to the model. To evaluate this hypothesis, we conducted a perplexity-based probe over relational information in AMR graphs. Our findings support our hypothesis, indicating that AMR augmentation does not provide any relational information that LLMs are not already capable of extracting from plain text.
blocks.zh: 鉴于AMR始终未能改进各种整合战略和任务类型的LLM性能,我们假设AMR并没有提供模型尚未掌握的任何关联信息LLM. 为了评价这个假说,我们对AMR图中的关系信息进行了基于迷惑的探测. 我们的结论支持我们的假设,即AMR扩增不能提供任何LLMs已经无法从纯文本中提取的关系信息。

blocks.en:
AMR ( Banarescu et al., 2013 ) is a semantic representation framework that is specifically designed to reflect “who does what to whom”: the schema centers on
predicate-argument relations. Using AMR,
each sentence is represented as a labeled, rooted directed acyclic graph, with nodes
representing concepts and edges encoding the relations between those concepts (see Figure 2 ). Among graph-based semantic representations such as
EDS ( Oepen and Lønning, 2006 ) and UCCA ( Abend and Rappoport, 2013 ) , AMR is the most popular and well-resourced ( Wein and Opitz, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
AMR(Banarescu等人,2013年)是一个语义代表框架,其具体设计是反映“谁对谁做什么”:计划的核心是:
上游辩证关系. 使用AMR系统,
每个句子都作为标签、根基定向环形图,带有节点
代表这些概念之间关系的概念和边缘(见图2)。 在基于图表的语义表述中,例如:
EDS(Oepen and Lønning,2006)和UCCA(Abend and Rappopport,2013),AMR是最受欢迎和资源最丰富的(Wein and Opitz,2024).

blocks.en:
Each AMR graph can be converted into a plain-text format using PENMAN notation ( Kasper , 1989 ; see Figure 2 ): this textual form is referred to as linearized AMR . The PENMAN format allows AMR to be processed using standard language models,
which would otherwise require graph-specific architectural modifications.
blocks.zh:
每个AMR图可以使用PENMAN Notation(Kasper,1989;见图2)转换成纯文本格式: 此文本形式称为线性AMR. PENMAN格式允许使用标准语言模型进行AMR处理,
否则需要针对具体图表的建筑修改。

blocks.en:
A substantial body of work leveraged AMR to improve model performance on downstream
NLP tasks for older generations of LMs. The most prevalent application domains are Information Extraction ( Xu et al., 2022 ; Zhang and Ji, 2021 ) , Question Answering ( Bonial et al., 2020 ; Xu et al., 2021 ) , and Summarization ( Hua et al., 2023 ; Hua et al., 2022 ) . AMR has also been applied to specialized domains such as mathematics ( Mansouri et al., 2022 ) and Spatial/Situated Dialogue ( Bonial et al., 2019 ; Bonial et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
大量工作利用AMR改进下游的示范业绩
NLP任务为年长的LMs. 最普遍的应用领域是信息提取(徐等人,2022年;张和智,2021年),问题回答(Bonial等人,2020年;徐等人,2021年),以及总结(Hua等人,2023年;Hua等人,2022年). AMR还应用于数学(Mansouri等人,2022年)和空间/位置对话(Bonial等人,2019年;Bonial等人,2023年)等专业领域。

blocks.en:
Several studies have explored AMR integration into systems revolving around modern LLMs: Jin et al. (2024) incorporated AMR into chain-of-thought
prompts; Yao et al. (2024) combined AMR with LLMs for sentence simplification; Shi et al. (2024) used AMR to enhance retrieval-augmented generation; Raut et al. (2025) systematically evaluated LLMs on linearized AMR-incorporated few-shot
prompts; and Zhang et al. (2025) incorporated linearized AMR into supervised
fine-tuning.

blocks.en: While the utility of AMR augmentation for older LMs is well-established, the question of its value for modern LLMs remains unanswered.
blocks.zh: 虽然AMR扩增对较古老的LMS的效用已经确立,但其对现代LLMs的价值问题仍然没有答案.

blocks.en:
Jin et al. (2024) first investigated the effect of integrating AMR into LLMs: they conducted training-free prompting
experiments in which the input text is supplemented with its corresponding linearized AMR. Empirical
results with GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 across multiple tasks show that incorporating AMR into LLMs
degrades model performance on average, and that it is difficult to predict for a given input whether AMR augmentation will be beneficial.
blocks.zh:
龚等. (2024年)首先调查了将AMR纳入LLMS的影响:他们进行了免费培训激励.
以相应的线性AMR补充输入文本的实验. 经验
GPT-3.5和GPT-4的多项任务结果表明,将AMR纳入LLMS
平均降低模型性能,而且很难预测某一输入的AMR扩增是否有益。

blocks.en:
Zhang et al. (2025) , however, argue that augmenting the LLMs’ inputs with linearized AMR—without fine-tuning the models themselves—is insufficient to determine the effectiveness of AMR augmentation, as LLMs are not necessarily inherently familiar with this data format. The authors conduct experiments on fine-tuning LLMs with AMR-augmented training data and evaluate their approach on ten tasks—five of which overlap with Jin et al. (2024) —showing that jointly training an LLM on text
augmented with
linearized AMR data yields improvements of up to 12 F1 points.
blocks.zh:
然而,Zhang等人(2025年)认为,用线化的AMR来增加LLMs的投入 -- -- 没有调整模型本身 -- -- 不足以确定AMR扩增的有效性,因为LLMs不一定从本质上熟悉这种数据格式。 作者们用AMR强化的训练数据对LLMS进行微调实验,并评价他们对十项任务——其中五项任务与Jin等人(2024年)重叠——采取的方法,表明联合培训了关于文本的LLM。

blocks.en: Our findings directly contradict those of Zhang et al. (2025) : we are unable to reproduce their results in our reimplementation, despite testing under a broad range of experimental conditions. We instead find evidence extending to fine-tuned settings the findings of Jin et al. (2024) that AMR augmentation does not benefit modern LLMs on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果直接与张等人(2025年)的结论相矛盾:尽管在广泛的实验条件下进行了试验,我们仍无法在重新实施中复制其结果. 相反,我们发现有证据表明,对Jin等人(2024年)的调查结果作了微调,即AMR扩增对下游任务的现代有限责任公司没有好处。

blocks.en:
Additionally, to the best of our knowledge, our experiments in Section 5 represent the first investigation into the reason for the inability of AMR augmentation to improve the downstream performance of LLMs,
thereby providing additional support to the findings of Jin et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh:
此外,据我们所知,我们对第5节的试验是首次调查,说明AMR扩增无法改善LLMS下游性能的原因,
因此,为Jin等人(2024年)的调查结果提供额外支持。

blocks.en:
For the other nine datasets, we kept the number of training samples as close as possible to those of Zhang et al. (2025) .
For each dataset, we parsed each instance into PENMAN-linearized AMR using AMR3-structbart-L ( Drozdov et al., 2022 ) , a SoTA AMR parser, to ensure high-quality, consistent AMR annotation.
blocks.zh:
对于其他9个数据集,我们尽可能将培训样本数量与张等(2025年)的样本数量相近.
对于每个数据集,我们使用AMR3-structbart-L(Drozdov等人,2022年),即SoTAAMR解析器,将每个实例解析为PENMAN线性AMR,以确保高质量、一致的AMR注释。

(2025) . At test time, the AMR-tuned models were evaluated only on AMR-augmented examples, as in Zhang et al. (2025) .

blocks.en: We fine-tuned each model across five seeds, and report the averaged results for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过五个种子对每个模型进行了微调,并报告了平均评价结果。

blocks.en: In addition to the joint fine-tuning procedure employed by Zhang et al. (2025) , we further fine-tuned and evaluated baseline (text only) and AMR-augmented models on each dataset individually.
blocks.zh: 除了Zhang等人(2025年)采用的联合微调程序外,我们还进一步对每个数据集的基线(仅文本)和AMR强化模型进行了微调和评估。

blocks.en: To control for the possibility that the AMR-augmented models may fail to leverage the AMR structures present in their fine-tuning data—i.e. they may simply ignore the AMR—we additionally implemented an intermediate fine-tuning procedure to familiarize the models with this representational format.
blocks.zh: 为了控制AMR强化模型在微调数据时可能无法利用现有的AMR结构——即它们可能只是忽略AMR——的可能性,我们还实施了中间微调程序,使模型熟悉这种代表格式。

blocks.en: Specifically, we first fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B models on AMR-to-text generation, using the AMR 3.0 corpus ( Knight et al., 2020 ) for training and evaluation (full training details and evaluation results for AMR-to-text are provided in Appendix B ). We then performed the AMR-augmented joint and individual fine-tuning, starting from the checkpoints trained on the intermediate AMR-to-text objective.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,我们首先对Llama-3.1-8B-Instructionct和Qune3-8B模型进行了关于AMR到文本生成的微调,使用AMR 3.0(Knight等人,2020年)来进行培训和评价(AMR到文本的全部培训细节和评价结果见附录B)。 然后,我们从接受中期AMR对文本目标培训的检查站开始,进行了AMR强化联合和个别微调。

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the joint and individual fine-tuning results for the text-only, AMR-augmented, and intermediate AMR-to-text (see Section 3.1.2 ) Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B models. The joint fine-tuned, AMR-augmented Llama-3.1 model (Llama-3.1, Joint, +AMR in Table 2 ) is a direct reimplementation of the configuration used in Zhang et al. (2025) . We additionally include the results reported by Zhang et al. (2025) for reference. Note that their +SR scores are averaged over three separate SR frameworks, including AMR, as Zhang et al. (2025) do not report a full performance breakdown by SR type. However, Zhang et al. (2025) report that AMR yields the greatest performance gains out of the SRs in their experiments (see their Table 11): if anything, the averaged figures in Table 2 understate the +AMR performance recorded by those authors.
blocks.zh: 表2列出仅文本、经AMR强化和中间AMR对文本的联合和个别微调结果(见第3.1.2节)。 Llama-3.1-8B-指令和Qune3-8B型号. 联合微调,AMR加固的Llama-3.1型号(Llama-3.1,United,+AMR在表2中)是张等(2025)使用的配置的直接重新实施. 此外,我们还将张等人(2025年)报告的结果作为参考。 请注意,他们的+SR分数平均在包括AMR在内的三个单独的SR框架上,因为张等人(2025年)没有按SR类型报告全面的性能细分. 然而,Zhang等人(2025年)报告说,在他们的实验中,AMR的性能收益最大(见表11):如果有的话,表2中的平均值低估了这些作者记录的+AMR性能.

blocks.en: In contrast to Zhang et al. (2025) , we find no consistent improvement from AMR augmentation across models, tasks, or training settings. Under a two-sided t t -test, we only find significant ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) differences between text-only and AMR-augmented performance on two of 36 configurations (see Table 3 ): Qwen3-8B under the individual training regime on SNLI (in favor of text-only) and for Llama-3.1-8B under the joint regime on SPIDER (in favor of +AMR).
blocks.zh: 与Zhang等人(2025年)相比,我们发现在模型、任务或培训环境中的AMR扩增并没有取得一致的改进。 在双侧 t - t 测试下,我们只发现在36个配置中的2个配置上,仅文本性能与AMR强化性能存在显著差异(p < 0.05 p < 0.05) (见表3):在SNLI(只支持文本)和Llama-3.1-8B(支持+AMR)联合机制下,在单独培训制度下,只有文本性能与AMR强化性能存在显著差异。

blocks.en: The observed discrepancy between our results and those of Zhang et al. (2025) is not due to a drastic decrease in our AMR-augmented models’ performance relative to the AMR-augmented results reported by those authors: in most cases, our AMR-augmented models actually perform better than in the experiments of Zhang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 我们与张等人(2025年)的结果之间观察到的差别并不是因为我们的AMR强化模型的性能与这些作者报告的AMR强化模型相比急剧下降:在大多数情况下,我们的AMR强化模型的实际性能比张等人(2025年)的实验要好.

blocks.en: Rather, the performance of the baseline, text-only models in Zhang et al. (2025) is substantially lower than the performance of our text-only models. As an example, Zhang et al. (2025) report an F1 score of 35.5 on SNLI for their text-only, fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model—this is far lower than we would expect given that even BERT Devlin et al. (2019) reaches ∼ \sim 91% accuracy on SNLI Nie et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 相反,在张等人(2025年)中,基准,文本专用模型的性能大大低于我们文本专用模型的性能. 例如,Zhang等人(2025年)报告说,SNLI的F1分数为35.5,因为只有文本,经过微调的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型——这远远低于我们预期的水平,因为即使BERT Devlin等人(2019年)在SNLI Nie等人(2020年)上也达到了91%的准确度。

blocks.en:
We therefore conclude that the results reported in Zhang et al. (2025) are likely due to a faulty experimental configuration:
the performance of text-only and AMR-augmented LLMs is roughly equal
regardless of the choice of fine-tuning regimen.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们的结论是,在张等人(2025年)中所报告的结果可能是由于实验配置有误:
仅文本和AMR强化LLMs的性能大致相等
不论选用何种微调方案.

blocks.en: 4 Multi-Sentence Tasks
blocks.zh: 4 多重任务

blocks.en: The baseline models’ performance on many of the tasks in Section 3 is near saturation: on SST-2, SNLI, PAWS, AGNews, and CoNLL2003, the text-only Llama-3.1 and Qwen3 models already achieve accuracy/F1 scores over 90%. It is therefore possible that AMR augmentation is simply unable to improve model performance on these tasks because there is no more room for improvement.
blocks.zh: 基线模型对于第3节许多任务的性能接近饱和度:在SST-2, SNLI, PAWS, AGNews, 和CoNLL2003上, 仅文本的Llama-3.1和Qune3模型已经取得了超过90%的精度/F1分数. 因此,AMR扩增可能根本无法改进这些任务的模型性能,因为没有更多的改进余地。

blocks.en: To account for this possibility, we extended our evaluation of AMR-augmented models to more difficult, multi-sentence tasks—such as passage-level summarization—where inputs involve richer and more complex linguistic structures.
blocks.zh: 为了考虑到这种可能性,我们扩大了对经强化的AMR模型的评估,使之包括更困难、更多种判决的任务——例如通过一级归纳——其中的投入涉及更丰富和更复杂的语言结构。

blocks.en: 4.1 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4.1 方法

blocks.en: We selected four multi-sentence datasets that require understanding complex linguistic and semantic structures: RAMS for event argument extraction ( Ebner et al., 2020 ) , CNN/DailyMail for summarization ( See et al., 2017 ) , ANLI for adversarial natural language inference ( Nie et al., 2020 ) , and LogiQA for reading comprehension ( Liu et al., 2020 ) . Dataset statistics are provided in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们选择了四个需要理解复杂的语言和语义结构的多判决数据集:RAMS用于事件论证提取(Ebner等人,2020年),CNN/DailyMail用于归纳(见等人,2017年),ANLI用于对抗性自然语言推论(Nie等人,2020年),LogiQA用于阅读理解(Liu等人,2020年). 数据集统计数据见表4。

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2 , prior work has demonstrated notable improvement from AMR augmentation for earlier generations of LMs on event argument extraction and summarization in particular ( Xu et al., 2022 ; Hua et al., 2023 ) . If modern LLMs can in fact benefit from AMR augmentation, it therefore stands to reason that we would expect to see the most substantial benefits on such tasks.
blocks.zh: 正如第2节所讨论的那样,以往的工作表明,在事件论证和归纳方面,对前几代的LMs的AMR扩增有显著改善(徐等人,2022年;华等人,2023年)。 如果现代有限责任公司实际上能够从AMR扩增中受益,那么我们有理由期望这些任务能得到最大的好处。

blocks.zh: 图3: 仅限文本(左)和AMR强化(右)提示多判决任务的模板.

blocks.en: To incorporate AMR structures into the multi-sentence inputs, we interleaved the AMR into the text: each linearized AMR graph is placed immediately after its corresponding sentence, encapsulated within special delimiter tokens ( <amr> … </amr> ) to clearly distinguish AMR from natural language content (see Figure 3 ). Full example prompts are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 为了将AMR结构纳入多判决输入中,我们将AMR插入文字:每个线性AMR图在相应句子之后立即放置,封装在特殊的分隔符(<amr>. </amr>)中,以明确区分AMR和自然语言内容(见图3)。 附录C提供了完整的提示。

blocks.en: The setup follows that of the single-sentence experiments of Section 3 . As in Section 3 , we experimented with joint and individual-task fine-tuning regimens, and evaluated standard fine-tuning along with a two-phase, intermediate AMR-to-text approach (see Section 3.1.2 ).
blocks.zh: 其设置沿用了第3节的单一判决实验. 与第3节一样,我们试验了联合和个人任务微调办法,并评价了标准微调,同时采用了两阶段的中间AMR到文本方法(见第3.1.2节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: The results of these experiments are given in Table 5 . Consistent with our single-sentence findings, we observe no meaningful improvement from AMR augmentation across all fine-tuning strategies and models: the performance of the AMR-augmented models remains on par with or below that of the text-only baseline across all four tasks.
blocks.zh: 这些实验的结果见表5。 根据我们的单一判决结论,我们发现在所有微调战略和模式中,AMR的扩大没有取得有意义的改进:AMR强化模式的绩效与所有四项任务中仅文本基线的绩效相同或低于该基准。

blocks.en: Table 4: Split sizes for the multi-sentence task datasets.
blocks.zh: 表4:多种判决任务数据集的分割大小。

blocks.en: Furthermore, note that the performance of the baseline, text-only models on these tasks is not near saturation (perhaps with the exception of ANLI). This indicates that the observed failure in Section 3 of AMR augmentation to improve LLMs’ downstream performance was not due to saturation on those tasks: across varying model types, fine-tuning regimens, and task difficulties, AMR augmentation consistently fails to markedly improve the performance of modern LLMs.
blocks.zh: 此外,请注意,关于这些任务的基准、仅文本模型的性能并非接近饱和(也许除ANLI之外)。 这表明,在AMR扩增第3节中观察到的改进LLMs下游性能的失败并不是因为这些任务的饱和程度:在不同的模式类型、精细调整办法和任务困难方面,AMR扩增一直未能显著改善现代LLMs的性能。

5 Relational Knowledge Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 关系知识分析

blocks.en: As the AMR representation A S A_{S} of a sentence S S is derived solely from S S itself—without the use of any other external source of information— A S A_{S} cannot possibly encode any more information than S S already contains. The utility of AMR lies instead in its explicit representation of structure: by making semantic relationships between entities overt and symbolic, AMR has the potential to help a model better extract the latent relational content already present in the text.
blocks.zh: 由于一个句子S S 的AMR 代表A S A_{S}完全来源于S S本身——没有使用任何其他外部信息来源——A A_{S]不可能比S S 已经包含的更多信息编码. AMR的有用之处在于它明确体现了结构:通过使实体之间的语义关系公开化和象征性化,AMR有可能帮助一个模型更好地提取文本中已经存在的潜在关系内容。

blocks.en: The observed failure of AMR augmentation to meaningfully improve downstream performance in the experiments of Sections 3 - 4 therefore raises the question as to whether modern LLMs require the structural guidance provided by AMR to infer semantic relationships encoded in the text. We posit that AMR does not improve the downstream performance of a modern LLM because it does not provide any relevant relational information not already available to the model.
blocks.zh: 因此,所观察到的AMR扩增未能在3-4节的实验中有意义地改善下游的性能,引起了一个问题,即现代的LLMs是否需要AMR提供的结构性指导来推断文本中编码的语义关系. 我们认为,AMR没有改进现代LLM的下游性能,因为它没有提供模型尚未掌握的任何相关关系信息。

blocks.en: In this section, we directly evaluate this conjecture (Section 5.1 ), and find evidence in support of our hypothesis that AMR augmentation does not improve LLMs’ understanding of sentence-level relational knowledge (Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们直接评价这种猜想(第5.1节),并找到证据支持我们的假设,即AMR扩增不会改善LLMs对判刑一级关系知识的理解(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1.1 AMR-NLD
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 AMR-NLD

blocks.en: As the relational content of an AMR graph is a structured symbolic object, it cannot be directly fed to a language model for likelihood evaluation. To empirically test our hypothesis, it is therefore necessary to transform the linearized AMR graphs of Sections 3 - 4 into AMR natural language descriptions ( Zhang et al., 2025 , AMR-NLD;) : natural language descriptions of the relational content of an AMR graph.
blocks.zh: 由于AMR图中的关系内容是一个结构化的符号对象,因此无法直接输入语言模型进行概率评价. 因此,为了在经验上检验我们的假设,有必要将第3-4节的线性AMR图转化为AMR自然语言描述(张等人,2025年,AMR-NLD;):对AMR图中关系内容的自然语言描述.

blocks.en: The AMR-NLD generation procedure that we employed is illustrated in Figure 4 : we first decomposed the AMR into core relational branches, then mapped each to a natural language sentence using Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) —the exact prompt used is provided in Appendix E.3 .
blocks.zh: 我们采用的AMR-NLD生成程序如图4所示:我们首先将AMR分解成核心关系分支,然后将每个分支绘制成自然语言句子。 Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Anthropic, 2025)——使用的准确的提示载于附录E.3.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 实验设置

blocks.en: We first randomly sampled 300 AMR-sentence pairs and then filtered to 178 pairs (Appendix E.1 ) from the PAWS test split used in our experiments in Section 3 , and used the procedure described in Section 5.1.1 to generate the AMR-NLD for each AMR, resulting in a dataset of 178 text, AMR, AMR-NLD triples ( S i , A S i , R S i ) (S_{i},A_{S_{i}},R_{S_{i}}) .
blocks.zh: 我们首先随机抽取300对AMR-判罚对数,然后从我们第3节实验中使用的PAWS测试分数中过滤到178对(附录E.1),并使用第5.1.1节中描述的程序生成每个AMR-NLD的AMR-NLD,结果形成了178个文本,AMR,AMR-NLD三重(Si,Ai,Ri)的数据集(S_{i},A_{S_{i}}i}},R_{S_{i}}i}}i}}).

blocks.en: Figure 4: Our AMR-NLD generation pipeline, illustrated with an example sentence. The AMR graph for the input sentence is decomposed into core relational branches (e.g. :ord, :poss, :time), each of which is mapped to an individual description in natural language.
blocks.zh: 图4:我们的AMR-NLD生成管道,以例句说明。 输入句的AMR图被分解为核心关系分支(如:ord,:poss,:time),每个分支被映射为自然语言中的单个描述.

blocks.en: We then evaluated a series of Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B models (see below), computing the perplexity of the AMR-NLD R S i R_{S_{i}} for each example conditioned on (i) the text S i S_{i} alone and (ii) S i S_{i} and its AMR A S i A_{S_{i}} .

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Perplexity scores by model configuration and input type are given in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 表7按模型配置和输入类型列出复杂度分数。

blocks.en: AMR augmentation consistently decreases perplexity for all model configurations, seemingly indicating that AMR does in fact provide the LLMs with additional relational information. However, there is no substantial difference between AMR-augmented perplexity and that of the AMR-nodes control condition: recall that this control condition consists of AMR structures that have been stripped of all relational information. This indicates that the observed differences in perplexity between the text-only and AMR-augmented conditions are due to spurious factors—for example the association of formal-logical structures with short, matter-of-fact statements.
blocks.zh: AMR扩增持续减少所有模型配置的迷惑性,似乎表明AMR事实上确实为LLM提供了额外的关系信息. 然而,AMR增强的迷惑性与AMR-节点控制条件之间没有实质性区别:回顾,这一控制条件由AMR结构组成,所有关系信息均已被剥夺。 这表明,所观察到的只有文本的条件与经AMR强化的条件之间的复杂性差异,是由于一些虚假因素造成的——例如,将正式的逻辑结构与简短的事实陈述联系在一起。

blocks.en: These results therefore support the hypothesis that AMR does not supply relational knowledge beyond what LLMs already infer from text, which is consistent with our results in Sections 3 and 4 : AMR augmentation offers no benefit to those models on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 因此,这些结果支持这样的假设,即AMR所提供的关系知识超出了LLMs从文本中已经推断的,这符合我们在第3和第4节中的结果:AMR扩增对于下游任务的这些模式没有任何好处。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigated whether augmenting LLM inputs with linearized AMR improves downstream performance. Across two model families, thirteen tasks spanning single- and multi-sentence settings, and several fine-tuning strategies, we found no consistent improvement over text-only baselines: this indicates that the AMR-augmented performance gains reported in prior work are likely due to specific experimental conditions or hyperparameter selection.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查了用线性AMR来增加LLM投入是否改善了下游的性能. 在两个模范家庭、13项涉及单一和多重判决环境的任务以及若干微调战略中,我们发现,相对于仅以文字为主的基线而言,没有始终如一的改进:这表明,以往工作中报告的AMR强化性能提高可能是由于具体的实验条件或超参数选择。

blocks.en: We then investigated why AMR augmentation does not benefit modern LLMs. A perplexity-based analysis indicated that AMR does not reduce an LLM’s uncertainty about the relational content of a sentence beyond the structure-free control. In other words, AMR augmentation does not provide relational knowledge beyond what is already extractable from text alone for modern LLMs.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们调查了为什么AMR扩增不能使现代有限责任公司受益。 一项基于迷惑的分析表明,AMR并不能减少LLM对句子在结构上不受控制的关系内容的不确定性. 换句话说,AMR扩增并不能提供超出仅从现代LLMs的文本中已经可以提取的关联知识.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our multi-seed experiments are limited to 8B parameter models (we conduct a single-seed 70B experiment in Appendix A.4 ); future work should assess the generalization of our findings to models of different sizes, and in particular examine whether there exists a relationship between model size and the effectiveness of SR integration.
blocks.zh: 我们的多种子实验仅限于8B参数模型(我们在附录A.4中进行单种子70B实验);今后的工作应当评估我们的调查结果对不同大小的模型的概括,特别是审查模型大小与SR集成的有效性之间是否存在关系.

blocks.en: We focus exclusively on the AMR semantic representation format. However, while AMR is the most popular and well-resourced SR format ( Wein and Opitz, 2024 ) , it is but one of many such formalisms: other SRs such as UCCA and UDS may interact differently with LLMs. Future work should extend our experiments to a broader range of semantic representations.
blocks.zh: 我们只注重AMR语义表述格式。 然而,虽然AMR是最受欢迎和资源最充足的SR格式(Wein and Opitz, 2024),但它只是许多这样的形式主义之一:其他的SR如UCCA和UDS可能与LLMs有不同互动. 今后的工作应当将我们的实验扩大到更广泛的语义表述。

blocks.en: Additionally, we do not study the potential effect of parser errors on the AMR-augmented models. While the observed performance of AMR-augmented models might be affected by parser errors, we argue that any AMR integration technique will also confront this same issue: it is an inherent limitation of AMR augmentation.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们不研究分析错误对AMR强化模型的潜在影响。 虽然观测到的AMR强化模型的性能可能受到解析错误的影响,但我们争辩说,任何AMR整合技术也会遇到同样的问题:这是AMR扩增的固有限制.

blocks.en: Finally, our study is limited to AMR integration at the fine-tuning stage, and there remains an open question as to whether semantic representations could be more effectively integrated at a more fundamental level such as during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的研究仅限于在微调阶段的AMR整合,还有一个未决问题,即语义表述是否可以在更基本的层面上,例如在预训期间,更有效地整合。

blocks.en:
We encode each sentence-level AMR graph with a 3-layer relational graph
convolutional network ( Schlichtkrull et al., 2018 ) of hidden dimension 768,
using 17 relation types obtained by bucketing the AMR edge labels. Node features are initialized from the
LLM’s own input embedding table by mean-pooling the subword embeddings of each
concept label, so the graph encoder and the language model share an input space. To project the resulting node representations into the LLM’s embedding space we
use a querying transformer (Q-Former) in the style of BLIP-2 ( Li et al., 2023 ) : K K learnable query vectors self-attend and then cross-attend to the node representations of a single graph, yielding a fixed
number of K K outputs per graph regardless of graph size, which a final linear
layer maps to the LLM embedding dimension. We place graph tokens immediately after its corresponding sentence. The
graph encoder and Q-Former are trained jointly with the LoRA adapters, while the
base LLM remains frozen.

blocks.en: Full system prompt for AMR-to-NLD generation You are an expert at reading AMR graphs and describing them in plain natural language. Given an AMR graph, decompose it into its core relational branches (such as :ord , :poss , :time , :ARG0 , :ARG1 , :location , etc.), map each branch to an individual natural language description, then aggregate all descriptions into a final coherent AMR-NLD (Natural Language Description). Rules: • No technical terms like ARG0, ARG1, op1, variable names, etc. • Decompose the AMR into its relational branches first, then map each to a sentence. • Each sentence should capture one relationship or branch from the AMR. • Aggregate the individual descriptions into a coherent, flowing final output. • Use natural pronouns and nouns to handle repeated entities. • If an argument is missing, skip it; do not mention it is absent. • Keep sentences simple and direct. • Ignore all index markers like ~1 , ~2 , ~3 in the AMR. • Output ONLY the final aggregated sentences, no preamble, no intro like “Here are the sentences…” or any other meta-commentary.
